description: SPIKE (spike/tauri-localhost-origin): grant the same permissions to the main window when it is served from the http://localhost origin (tauri-plugin-localhost). A window loading http://localhost is REMOTE context, so the default (local) capability does NOT apply and invoke/IPC would be blocked without this. local:false keeps this inert for dev / flag-off (tauri:// or devUrl) builds. Port must match LOCALHOST_PORT in src/lib.rs.
